name: @hl-bos/hype-video
description: 5-Star Hype Video engine (5-Star Sports Media). Turns athlete details, a template and a tone into a complete hype package: title, 15- and 30-second scripts, voiceover, caption, hashtags, on-screen text, video prompt, music prompt and sponsor callout. The built-in template writer needs no key; Claude is an optional provider behind the same interface, and every draft from any provider passes the same fabrication and moderation checks before it can be saved.
